notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
- Added music to the credits
- Fixed an issue where the opening the options menu while in the credits would crash the game
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't unlock the "Go Outside Now," "Finishing Fast, Are We?" "Overachiever," and "Stop Cheating" achievements.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1: Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
We've updated the game to patch some bugs that have showed up on the first day of release!
- Fixed a bug where a hitbox in Sylvano Mountain Base was too short, allowing players to clip through a wall.
- Fixed a bug where after completion of the game, starting from Lurielle Village, backing out, and then going to Sacred Summit would cause the timer to start from 0:00 on the level.
- Fixed a bug where the credits cutscene would play audio at max volume, even if volume was turned down.
- Added a Final Time counter to the credits, so you can easily share your best time!

Stay tuned, we're working on a leaderboard system for the best times throughout the game!

notes.title: Level Showcase: Sylvan Sanctuary
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the fifth Level Showcase for Echoes of Eldoria! Today, we'll be offering a look at the fourth level of the game, [b]Sylvan Sanctuary[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/df59f0bc2be627bef2077b5a0dcdada2a20bd55b.png[/img]

After the mysterious Reisa Sands, the young wizard finally regained his abilities! However, he still needs to find his way to the dragon to prove his worth, and it certainly won't be an easy task...
As he climbs through the [b]Sylvan Sanctuary[/b], the wizard will find new [b]blue targets[/b], which will allow him to swing across the jungle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/fa2fc0fce830aad2970889e1a7386119d7d6fcc9.png[/img]

notes.title: Level Showcase: Reisa Sands
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the fourth Level Showcase for Echoes of Eldoria! Today, we'll be offering a look at the third level of the game, [b]Reisa Sands[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/7c990807657ff2a8aca27af22e19bf73e6cd210d.png[/img]

By the time the wizard climbs out of the towering Faelyn Falls, the sun has set and it is now nighttime. However, the wizard has no time to rest! Luckily, his next challenge is the desert ruins of Reisa Sands, filled with old [b]torches that the wizard can reignite[/b] to light his way forward! As he climbs through the mysterious ruins, the wizard searches for his lost [b]Gravity Grasps[/b], which can be worn to [b]reverse gravity when the wizard is near certain zones[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/a218e7b4c227e0eae9b45376482cef197ffa3cb9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/aba065f9f3301dca7e2b8771e96905de2351b375.png[/img]

Stay tuned for future Level Showcases!

notes.title: Level Showcase: Faelyn Falls
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the third Level Showcase for Echoes of Eldoria! Today, we'll be offering a look at the second level of the game, [b]Faelyn Falls[/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/ef0e42e844434e66a21a6a72bebbcfc0038e54f6.png[/img]

After the wizard climbs through the serene Sylvano Mountain Base, he finds himself at the base of various towering waterfalls: Faelyn Falls. These falls are said to be where this world began from, and are full of streams and cliffs that the wizard will have to climb expertly. Additionally, somewhere in the level lies the wizard's lost [b]Glacial Glare[/b], which can be retrieved and used to [b]create platforms from falling debris![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/ea6bb613468f72c5e7b752dde773cf92c4a7d987.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/8626e7a38df3451da66c9477b5d9ca2eef50bbc8.png[/img]

Stay tuned for future Level Showcases!

notes.title: Level Showcase: Sylvano Mountain Base
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the second Level Showcase for Echoes of Eldoria! Today, we'll be offering a look at the first full level of the game, Sylvano Mountain Base:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/51a376231a9956e482ddbc3acd8ace5eab945a7c.png[/img]

Taking place right after you lose your powers, Sylvano Mountain Base allows you to reacquaint yourself with the basics of platforming in Echoes of Eldoria, Very early into the level you regain your Fleetfoot Amulet, allowing you once again to dash to far platforms! As you traverse, you'll encounter the first of various puzzles and regain another exciting ability!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/18467054b3b391d4211b80c0a97f25e2c9cd9d6f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/8f2e8711dff40b6415fe3d1034ded46ae422e554.png[/img]

Stay tuned for future Level Showcases!

notes.title: Level Showcase: Lurielle Village
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the first Level Showcase for Echoes of Eldoria! We'll be starting at the beginning, and offering a look at [b]Lurielle Village:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/42cd9b6f73d205a1b04604ca606c4fe1d2e2db52.png[/img]

As the first place you visit, Lurielle Village acts as the section where you first learn about your unique abilities and some of their various uses. Throughout the level, you will [b]dash, freeze, and flip[/b] your way through a village as you escape from the mob chasing you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/b610f6ed42fb8bf9ae1a95a01a64903e4443cd57.png[/img]

At this point of the story, the wizard has just stolen a [b]very important staff[/b] from the village and is being chased out of their home. As one of the most [i][b]intense and exciting[/b][/i] levels in the lineup, the explosive beginning that is Lurielle Village is sure to grab your attention!

Stay tuned for future Level Showcases!

notes.title: The Speedrun Competition has Officially Begun!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Steam Next Fest! 
As previously mentioned, we are hosting a fun [i][b]Speedrunning Competition[/b][/i] with our demo. Here are the official details below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/cee7530ab4ca8d9ba2d9b522aed734b84a38545d.png[/img]
Participants that record a run of playing the [i]Echoes of Eldoria[/i] Demo and post it to one of these social media sites with the hashtag [i][b]#EOESpeedrun[/b][/i] will be entered. These sites include:
[list]
[*] Youtube
[*] X
[*] Instagram
[*] Tiktok
[/list]

[b]Be sure to upload on a platform you check often, as winners will be contacted through the comments![/b]

[b]OFFICIAL RULES:[/b]
- You may not skip levels during a run (using the menu to go to the Mountain Base without having completed the tutorial)
- The game cannot be closed during a run
- The run begins when the timer starts in the tutorial level and ends when you receive your final time in the wishlist screen
- Use of the game's natural bugs and glitches is [b]allowed[/b] to speed up gameplay
- Use of external programs are [b]not allowed[/b] (ex. CheatEngine, WeMod)
- We will individually review all entries, so [b]do not worry if your timer does not work properly[/b]
- Runs that violate these rules will not be considered for prizes
- Each contestant will only have their top submission considered
- All submissions must be submitted before [b]March 3rd at 10:00 AM PT[/b]

You can submit as many entries as you'd like! Once you are entered, there's nothing much to worry about until the end of the competition. Once the competition is over, we will go through the submissions and find the [b]Top 3[/b] winners!

These winners will receive:
[b]1st Place[/b]: A [b]$100 USD Steam Gift Card[/b] + a free copy of Echoes of Eldoria when it releases!
[b]2nd Place[/b]: A [b]$50 USD Steam Gift Card[/b] + a free copy of Echoes of Eldoria when it releases!
[b]3rd Place[/b]: A [b]$20 USD Steam Gift Card [/b] + a free copy of Echoes of Eldoria when it releases!

The competition will end on [b]March 3rd[/b], in accordance with Next Fest. Good luck, and we hope to see your submission!

notes.title: Official Steam Next Fest Announcement! + Speedrunning Competition
notes.notes:
Hi all,

We're excited to announce that we will officially be participating in Steam's [i][b]February Next Fest 2025[/b][/i]! With it, we have implemented various new improvements to our demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/aa8f8ba0dd7ccb682d43c2b2a30de81d56e76b7c.png[/img]

In addition, throughout the duration of Steam Next Fest, we will be running our [b][i]Echoes of Eldoria Next Fest Speedrunning Competition![/i] [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45324091/9fb0cc03185e3a79cbf1412537602bcce9ade4d4.png[/img]

Throughout Reddit, X, Instagram, Tiktok, and Youtube, participants who record gameplay speedrunning our Next Fest Demo and tag it with [b]#EOESpeedrun[/b] will be entered. By the end of Next Fest, the winners will be awarded:
[b][i]1st Place: 100 Dollar Steam Gift Card + a free key for the full release of [I]Echoes of Eldoria[/i]![/i][/b]
[b][i]2nd Place: 50 Dollar Steam Gift Card + a free key for the full release of [I]Echoes of Eldoria[/i]![/i][/b]
[b][i]3rd Place: 20 Dollar Steam Gift Card + a free key for the full release of [I]Echoes of Eldoria[/i]![/i][/b]
We look forward to seeing your gameplay clips and the start of Next Fest. Stay tuned for more updates on the Speedrunning Competition!
- Roobec
